role_legend.B: border (BORDER px ring); colour depends on state
role_legend.M: selected marker; drawn as the face colour unless the button is selected

states.selected: mouse is over the key (hover); uses the nav-clock mouse
states.pressed: mouse is over the key and the left button is held

glyph_format: glyphs[name][char] is a list of rows (top first) of '0'/'1', char 0 leftmost; drawn scaled by FONT5_SCALE (5x7) or FONT3_SCALE (3x5); already rendered into role_map 'X'
pixel_rule: Inside the region: background; inside an enabled key: key.state_colors[state][role_map[ly][lx]] (later keys win on overlap; keys do not overlap here).
